pages.title: A ride to work · 1/3
paragraphs: It is lunchtime in a busy office in Atlanta. Lia looks at her phone and sighs. The mechanic says her car needs two days. She needs a ride to work. Her coworker Kim sits at the next desk. Lia turns to her with a shy smile.
“Hi, Kim. My car is in the shop. Can I get a ride tomorrow?” says Lia. “Sure! Where do you live?” says Kim. “Near the park, on Oak Street.” says Lia.
